name: agent-panel
about: An agent at work in lab-sandbox from a Code chat, its cards allowed: shots of the Agent panel beside the chat and the thread's to-do card while it runs and once it's done, in both themes. Then a plan nobody acts on: Needs you while it waits, and "Plan not used" in Finished (not Needs you) once a newer agent runs in the same Code chat. Then a Bypass permissions Code chat asked to catch up on the workspace: no card or question asked, the agent read only at Bypass (never a plan to approve), done. Its `fake` steps play only in a --fake lab (the stand-in agent), so the script's own flow can be checked offline.
